theme: An open day, and a few bookings that have waited long enough.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Nothing is on the calendar today, which makes it the right day to close the travel bookings that keep slipping and to glance at the agenda for tomorrow's early ICGN call.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority task has sat open since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold costs nothing and removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: December break needs a destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by and book-by dates have both passed. All four girls, Dec 13 to Jan 2, over the holidays: the thinnest inventory of the year for six people, so the longer this waits the fewer options remain.

needsAttention.title: Read the ICGN Toronto plenary outline
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 7:30 AM planning call for the stewardship-data plenary asks everyone to arrive having read the session outline Claudia circulated. A skim tonight means you walk in ready to discuss rather than catch up.
